source.title: WCAT Leader Announcement (October 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Lars Johan Folde will become the new Leader of the WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT). Lars Johan was already working as the interim Leader of the WCAT.

Lars Johan was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of October 1, 2026.

We thank Roman Wofford for the work he did as the leader and wish Lars Johan the best of luck in fulfilling his duties.

Lars Johan was one of the three applications we received. You can view all the candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EtLQTtjVRdkOD54irl19-61iB0hn-Uyz?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示组负责人任命公告（2026 年 10 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Lars Johan Folde 将担任 WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）的新任负责人。Lars Johan 此前已担任 WCAT 临时负责人。

WCA 董事会依据《WCA 委员会与团队[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)》第 5 节，选出 Lars Johan，并通过投票批准了这一任命。任命自 2026 年 10 月 1 日生效。

我们感谢 Roman Wofford 担任负责人期间所做的工作，并祝 Lars Johan 履职顺利。

我们共收到三份申请，Lars Johan 是其中一位申请人。所有申请材料均可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EtLQTtjVRdkOD54irl19-61iB0hn-Uyz?usp=drive_link)查看。
